components.role: Candidate first-person belief-cue binding, stronger in A. The directional projection-weight change survives global query/key gain removal; user-role specificity and causal deference remain unverified.
Candidate correction/conflict-feature remapping; agreement-associated changes survive lexical and numerical-overlap controls, with incorrect/erroneous vocabulary associations.
Candidate correction/conflict-feature remapping related to layer 9; associations persist beyond generic-negation and numerical-overlap controls.
Candidate broad late output/readout remapping; strongest output-side difference under tested readout metrics, robust to vocabulary-subset controls.
Candidate numerical-content transfer change favoring A across tested numeral representations; matching interpretation depends on feature and relative position.
Candidate numeral-form transfer change favoring A, strongest for digit glyphs; both output and shared value maps contribute.
Candidate numerical matching and transfer pathway; both examined matching-difference measures favor A across all tested relative distances.
Additional numeral-transfer candidate favoring A for digit glyphs, with mixed number-word generalization and position-dependent matching changes.
Countervailing numeral-transfer candidate favoring B for several digit representations; mainly an output-projection change.
Candidate content-matching change; largest individual-head query-difference spectral norm, with feature-, weighting- and position-dependent interpretation.

evidence: Twenty-four weight-only runs without model execution, activations, training or behavioral evaluation. Layer 1 head 3 has a robust first-person-belief association stronger in A; removing whole-map query/key gains changes the think-I difference by only about 0.01%, and the relevant stored normalization weights are exactly unchanged. MLPs 9 and 10 retain correction-associated directional changes after lexical and numerical-overlap controls. Late numerical-transfer differences provide supporting but mixed evidence, including B-favoring counterexamples. Embeddings, output weights and final normalization are identical. A at 0.60 is a tentative inference, not verified behavior. Components are ranked investigation candidates; contextual functions, circuit connectivity and causal importance remain unestablished.
